chunks: And it is narrated: regarding a man who goes out naked and the salat overtakes him, he prays naked standing if no one sees him; and if someone sees him, he prays sitting.

key_terms.اَلصَّلَاةُ: the obligatory salat whose time has arrived
key_terms.يَرَهُ: sees him or looks at him

ai.seo_question: How should a person pray if the time of salat comes while he has no clothing?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling for one who has no clothing when the time of salat arrives. He should pray standing if he is not seen by anyone, but if he is visible to others, he should pray sitting in order to preserve modesty as much as possible.
